basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas. I've been a fan of Pokemon since I was a kid, and I love combining my passion for gaming with technology. When I'm not working on code, I'm either catching Pokemon in Pokemon Go or digging into the latest tech news. I enjoy connecting with other trainers and sharing tips and strategies. I'm single, and I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for about 5 years. My expertise spans across software development, with a keen interest in app development and gaming technologies. I'm largely self-taught when it comes to gaming strategies, having spent countless hours researching and playing.
